svg.title: 3°, 111° and 333° direction-address comparison
svg.desc: 3 and 111 degrees visit the same 120 circle points in different order. 333 degrees visits only 40 directions and repeats them three times.
svg.text: R=1 · common start 0° · 120 steps · same orientation and scale
PASS · A and B preserve the complete point set; edge order changes. 333° loses 80 addresses.
